name: together.ai OG social card — gradient cloud hero by together.ai
description: A 1200×630 social card that treats its background as light rather than imagery: a hazy sky-blue gradient wash fills the canvas, with a soft blurred 3D curve occupying the right half and a single thin diagonal light streak cutting across it. All content is stacked in one left column — a compact logo lockup (three overlapping lavender, magenta and orange dots beside a black lowercase wordmark) sitting above a two-line headline where the first line is heavy near-black and the second drops to a lighter gray at the same size. The bottom third stays completely empty, which keeps the card legible at thumbnail scale and gives the composition its airy, unhurried rhythm.
